elements.element: Customer has no minimum purchase or volume commitment.
elements.evidence: Section 2.1 expressly states that Customer “has no minimum purchase or volume commitment,” consistent with Section 12.3.

elements.element: Customer pays only for usage or ordered Services.
elements.evidence: Section 2.1 states that Customer “will pay only for Services used or ordered during the applicable term.”

elements.element: The commitment is limited to the current 12-month term.
elements.evidence: No commitment exists under rendered Section 2.1, so the fallback condition requiring limits on an existing commitment is inapplicable.

elements.element: Customer may reduce the commitment on 30 days' notice.
elements.evidence: No commitment exists to reduce; the conditional fallback protection is therefore unnecessary and satisfied by the demonstrable absence of any commitment.

elements.element: Any shortfall is handled through a true-up rather than a penalty.
elements.evidence: Because Section 2.1 imposes no commitment, no shortfall can arise and neither a true-up nor a penalty applies.
